sources.entry: Gitify - Your GitHub notifications on your menu bar.

summary.one_liner: Gitify is a cross-platform desktop tray/menu bar app that aggregates GitHub and other Git forge notifications into one place.
summary.what_it_does: Gitify shows notifications from Git platforms in the macOS menu bar, Windows, or Linux tray. It supports multiple forges through an adapter pattern: GitHub Cloud, GitHub Enterprise, Gitea, Forgejo, Codeberg, Bitbucket Cloud, and GitLab. Users can authenticate with one or many accounts. Per the forge support table, GitHub Cloud supports notifications, mark read, mark done, unsubscribe, and enriched details. The README also mentions customizable settings, filters, and themes. It can be installed via Homebrew on macOS or built locally with pnpm.
use_cases: monitor GitHub notifications from the menu bar
track notifications across multiple Git forges
view GitHub Enterprise or Gitea alerts in one place
triage pull request and issue notifications
get desktop notifications for Git activity
notable: Multi-forge support via a forge adapter pattern (GitHub, Gitea, Forgejo, Codeberg, Bitbucket Cloud, GitLab)
Per-forge feature matrix covering mark read, mark done, and unsubscribe
caveats: Some forge adapters are listed with experimental, in-progress, or considering statuses; new forges need an adapter and a designated maintainer
Building from source requires pnpm and a development setup described in CONTRIBUTING.md
